big_case.notes: Although specialist counsel later appeared and five amici filed in support of the petition's Rooker-Feldman and parental-rights arbitration framing, this pro se-filed collateral attack arose from a two-page unpublished Ninth Circuit Rule 36-3 memorandum with fatal vehicle defects—explicit de facto appeal pleading in the complaint, independent judicial/sovereign and arbitral immunity grounds, and an expired restraining order—and ended in a routine first-conference cert denial after respondent waivers without a call for a response.
